cards.title: Kindness of strangers helps overwhelmed parent
cards.body: A motorway mishap turned into a moment of human connection when a stranger helped clean up after a child got sick in the car. The story highlights how unexpected kindness from others can ease parenting stress.

cards.title: Family memoir sparks relationship conflict
cards.body: A sister-in-law's published memoir raised questions about family loyalty and truthfulness in personal storytelling. The advice column explores how families navigate differing perspectives on shared experiences.

cards.title: Ikea trip reveals parenting wisdom gaps
cards.body: A parent discovers how little domestic knowledge they've actually passed on to their child during a pre-university shopping trip. The humorous reflection shows what kids do and don't learn from everyday parenting.

cards.title: Healthy phone practices for teens and tweens
cards.body: Parents face an important decision about when to give children their first phone and how to set healthy expectations. The article weighs key considerations for managing technology use in young people.

cards.title: Stop blaming kids for addictive technology design
cards.body: The real problem isn't screens themselves but the algorithms designed to capture children's attention and manipulate reward systems. Understanding how technology shapes developing brains helps parents approach screen time more thoughtfully.

cards.title: What screen time is actually replacing matters
cards.body: Before limiting children's screen time, parents should ask what activities the screens are replacing. This question reveals whether restrictions address the root issue or just manage symptoms.

cards.title: Deep-fried foods banned in school meals
cards.body: England introduces major new school food standards that restrict deep-fried items to support children's health. The government describes the changes as a once-in-a-generation reform of school nutrition.
